notes.title: First look at Sim Management in Escape Room Simulator
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=6ieRd9Pk_cY;full][/previewyoutube]

We're excited to reveal that in #EscapeRoomSim, not only will you be able to escape rooms, you'll be able to build and manage your very own virtual Escape Room empire!

Escape. Build. Manage. Profit. 😍

We're working on some really cool tools which will not only allow you to design your rooms, it'll draw you further into the world by placing you at the helm of building an Escape Room experience to rival all others.

We've tonnes more exciting stuff we can't wait to reveal, very soon we'll be launching the first of many planned playable demos, as well as looking at setting up development streams to give you a better insight into Escape Room Simulator as it progresses!

We hope you are as excited as we are!
